title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution with Encoded Command
description: Detects PowerShell processes launched with -EncodedCommand or -enc parameter, commonly used by attackers to obfuscate malicious scripts. High false-positive rate in environments with heavy PowerShell automation — tune the exclusion list.
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-EncodedCommand", "-encodedcommand")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("svchost.exe", "services.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc
author: your-github-handle
tuning_notes: Exclude known automation accounts and SCCM/Intune management scripts. Add your org-specific exclusions to the InitiatingProcessFileName filter.

title: PowerShell Download Cradle
description: Detects PowerShell download cradle patterns (IEX, Invoke-Expression with web requests).
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("IEX", "Invoke-Expression", "Invoke-WebRequest", "Invoke-RestMethod", ".DownloadString")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
author: sentinel-contrib

title: Script Interpreter Spawned by Office
description: Script interpreters (PowerShell, cmd, wscript) launched by Office applications — potential macro or DDE abuse.
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
author: blue-team

title: Sign-in from Impossible Travel Location
description: Detects sign-ins that would require impossible travel between two locations (time and distance).
kql:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Location, IPAddress, AppDisplayName
| sort by UserPrincipalName, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend PrevLocation = prev(Location), PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser and PrevTime > ago(1d)
| where location_diff(Location, PrevLocation) > 1000
author: identity-team
tuning_notes: Adjust distance threshold (km) and time window per environment.

title: Local Account Logon on Domain-Joined Device
description: Local account (non-domain) logon on a device that is domain-joined — may indicate stolen local creds or persistence.
kql:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where AccountDomain != "" and AccountDomain !contains ("\\")
| summarize Count=count() by DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain, bin(Timestamp, 1d)
| where Count > 0
author: endpoint-team

title: Phishing Email with Malicious Link
description: Emails with high confidence phishing URL clicks or delivery.
kql:
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| where DeliveryAction in ("Delivered", "Junked", "Blocked") or ClickAction == "ClickAllowed"
| join kind=inner EmailUrlInfo on NetworkMessageId
| where UrlCategory == "Phishing" or PhishScore > 0.8
| project TimeGenerated, Subject, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Url, PhishScore
author: email-security

title: RDP Connections to Multiple Hosts
description: Single account initiating RDP to many different hosts in a short window — lateral movement pattern.
kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemotePort == 3389
| summarize DestCount=dcount(DeviceName), DestHosts=make_set(DeviceName) by AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DestCount >= 5
author: soc-team
tuning_notes: Tune DestCount threshold for admin and support workflows.

title: Bulk Phishing Campaign - Same Sender
description: Same sender address sending to many recipients in a short time — bulk phishing campaign.
kql:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
| summarize RecipientCount=count(), Recipients=make_set(RecipientEmailAddress) by SenderFromAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where RecipientCount > 20
author: soc-team

title: PowerShell with Bypass Execution Policy
description: PowerShell launched with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass — often benign but worth reviewing in locked-down environments.
kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "-ExecutionPolicy" and ProcessCommandLine contains "Bypass"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
author: detection-library

title: Risky User Sign-in
description: Sign-ins flagged by Azure AD Identity Protection as risky.
kql:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium") or RiskDetail != ""
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskDetail, AppDisplayName
author: identity-team
